title: Transpiling
body:
Translating source code into equivalent source code in a different dialect of the same language — modern [[JavaScript]] into a version older browsers understand, or TypeScript/JSX into plain JS. Babel and TypeScript's compiler are the usual tools, run as part of the [[Module Bundler]] pipeline.

Translating tomorrow's dialect into one every audience member understands. It's a **build-time** step: the end user's browser only ever receives the already-translated output. Note that transpiling handles *syntax* (arrow functions, `async`/`await`, optional chaining) but cannot conjure missing *APIs* — a browser with no `Promise` needs a polyfill, which is a separate thing entirely. Debugging the output requires [[Source Maps]].
